subject.title: fix(hooks): bound HOOK.md reads during hook install validation

question: Should this PR proceed only after real hook-install proof for the oversized HOOK.md path, or should a maintainer override the proof gate and accept the unit-test-only evidence?
rationale: The patch changes a security-sensitive install boundary and adds a new hard compatibility limit, while the current PR evidence only cites a focused test run.

options.title: Require real install proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal or live output that installs a throwaway oversized-hook package and shows the new size-limit failure before merge.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the unit-test-only evidence if they consider this XS security patch sufficiently proven.

options.title: Revise limit shape
options.body: Ask for a different cap or streaming frontmatter parser if a hard 1 MiB HOOK.md failure is not the desired product boundary.

recommendation.title: Require real install proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal or live output that installs a throwaway oversized-hook package and shows the new size-limit failure before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history-backed owner for the hook install and filesystem hardening paths touched by this PR.
